title: Your Dream Can Change
source_body:
Your Dream Can Change

When I was eight, I wanted to be a firefighter. At eleven, I dreamed of becoming a famous singer. Now, at fifteen, I want to be a science teacher. Whenever my dream changed, I felt a little embarrassed, as if I had failed at something.

Recently, however, I realized that changing dreams is completely natural. As we grow older, we learn more about the world and about ourselves. We discover new interests and find out what we are truly good at. It would actually be strange if our dreams stayed the same forever.

Interestingly, none of my old dreams were a waste of time. Wanting to be a firefighter taught me how important it is to help others. Practicing singing gave me the confidence to speak in front of people. Both of these experiences will help me become a better teacher someday.

So if you don't have a clear dream yet, or if your dream keeps changing, don't worry. What matters is not having the "right" answer now. What matters is continuing to explore, try new things, and learn about yourself. Every step you take is part of your journey.
